summary.text: Suzzann Nordwick is the Republican candidate for the Montana House of Representatives, District 71, in the November 3, 2026 general election against incumbent Scott DeMarois (D).

paragraphs.text: Suzzann Nordwick lists her profession as engineer on Ballotpedia and was a delegate from Montana to the 2016 Republican National Convention.
She was unopposed in the 2014 Republican primary for the Montana House of Representatives and lost the general election to incumbent Gordon Pierson (D).

Nordwick was the Republican nominee for Montana State Senate District 39 in 2016, losing to incumbent Gene Vuckovich (D), and again in 2020, when Mark Sweeney (D) defeated her, 44.4 percent to 43.0 percent.
In 2022 she lost the general election for Montana House of Representatives District 76 to incumbent Donavon Hawk (D).
She also ran in the 2024 Republican primary for Montana Public Service Commission District 3, which Jeffrey Welborn won, and advanced from the June 2, 2026 Republican primary for House District 71.
